text:
ashley: Quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem  we need firm owners and dates for remediation: quota guardrails, scheduler tuning, headroom runbook, and automated alerts. Can folks claim items?

miguel: I can own quota guardrails. Deliverable: short spec for per-customer burst caps + credit bucket + admin override. Target Tue EOD (1958887600).

kevin: Scheduler tuning is mine. I'll run a small staging sweep (bin-packing weight, affinity, preemption scope) and post numbers. Target Thu (1959050400).

ashley: I'll draft the emergency headroom runbook (detection, comms, mitigation steps like model-pool fallback, auto-rollout caps). Draft by Fri (1959136800).

jane: Product: require a soft block on auto-rollouts when spare_gpus < 25%. I'll produce the requirement list by Tue (1958887600).

sara: Note: Dedicated customers need a separate policy (no auto-migration). Add to runbook.

dmitri: Ops automation: ops-bot will post daily spare GPU snapshots and create REM ticket when spare_gpus < 15% for two checks. Prototype alert rule: `expr: spare_gpus_percent < 15 for 10m` -> create REM. Prototype by next Mon (1959273600).

kevin: Tiny config I'll test in staging (pseudo): `desiredHeadroom: 0.20; binPacking.weightMemory: 1.6; preemption.scope: group`.

miguel: Also adding a 48h post-remediation spike test to validate changes.

ashley: Owners recap: quota - miguel (Tue 1958887600); scheduler - kevin (Thu 1959050400); runbook - ashley (Fri 1959136800); ops-bot alerts - dmitri (Mon 1959273600); fallback reqs - jane (Tue 1958887600). I'll open REM tickets and track.

ops-bot: reminder-created "Headroom remediation weekly sync" every Mon 09:30 in #incidents. First run: 1958854200. jira-created: REM-7456 assigned-to: miguel, REM-7457 assigned-to: kevin, REM-7458 assigned-to: ashley (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REM-7456).

sara: Thanks all. We'll review progress in the weekly ops check-in. Close thread once tickets are live and initial drafts posted. :thumbsup:
